messages:
maya: spotting a weird spike: SSE streams for several tenants got duplicate ":end" events after resume. billing anomalies reported. anyone else?

josh: saw same. quick grep of proxy logs shows resume replay includes the final :end chunk even when :end was already sent.

lina: sample log:
```
[13:04:01.001] send: {chunk seq=102}
[13:04:01.002] send: :end
[13:04:01.050] resume replay start seq=100
[13:04:01.051] send: :end  <-- duplicated
```

maya: likely bug in replay window bounds. we define replay as [start_seq, start_seq+N] but terminal frames shouldn't be part of replay.

infra-bot: deploy-canary proxy v4.0.1 starting -> pool-c

josh: quick mitigation: add guard to skip frames with prefix ":end" when replaying. I'll open a small PR.

lina: also add a metric `stream.resume.terminal_replayed` so console can show impacted orgs. console-team can surface it?

console-team: yes, we can add a panel and temporary banner. add org tag in metric.

maya: rollout plan: canary -> monitor replay metric and billing delta for 20m -> promote. rollback: disable resume feature flag on pool-c.

josh: PR: https://git.redwood/proxy/compare/patch/replay-skip-term. unit tests included.

infra-bot: canary deploy v4.0.1 to pool-c completed (id: can-903).

josh: initial canary: terminal_replayed=0.4% (was 15%). billing spikes reduced.

lina: good. follow-ups: add server-side billing dedupe by (org,stream,frame-hash) 10s window, update resume docs, and include resume metrics in public usage UI.

maya: agree. can someone draft a short blurb for eng-all about root cause + mitigation?

josh: I'll do a 2-line blurb with link to console panel.

console-team: banner up and ops doc updated. marking thread resolved after prod promote.

maya: promoting in 10m. thanks everyone :white_check_mark:

infra-bot: promote v4.0.1 scheduled to prod pools.
